Resolves #18654
Refs #17844

Four Workstation Neural Link arms stop pinning values the app changed after they were written, and all nine arms in their two files now pass run whole.
- The store-backed perspective chain asserts a committed left extent that its disruption moves, instead of a `0.2` the shipped document no longer has.
- The pop-out Group arm expects the vessel key the Workstation mints, `workstation-vessel:feed`, instead of the engine's `popup:` default.
- The cold-topology helper expects the declared perspective identity that #18648 added to the Workstation's Group snapshot. Its two arms are this PR's delta from the census.

Evidence: L3 achieved — both spec files run whole against the external Brain runtime at the head → L3 required for AC-4. These specs are ignored without `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` and run in no CI workflow. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `WorkstationPerspectivesNL.spec.mjs:79–86`: the precondition expects a number, and one that is not the disruption's `0.32`. The arm passes end to end at f07b5375d7. |
| AC-2 | `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL.spec.mjs:554` expects `'workstation-vessel:feed'`, the value the census received. The arm at `:496` passes end to end. |
| AC-3 | `expectColdTopology` (`WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL.spec.mjs:194`) expects `$perspective:workstation-main: {name: 'shipped'}` beside the documents and placement hints. The arms at `:316` and `:471` pass. |
| AC-4 | Both files whole at f07b5375d7: 9 passed, 0 failed (command below). |
| AC-5 | Once the two census constants stopped failing, nothing else in their arms was masked. The only new red was `:316`/`:471` from #18648, fixed here as AC-3. |
| AC-6 | #17844's current-state block, republished 2026-09-13T11:57:39Z, lists both census arms under #18654 and this PR, not as unowned. |
